paper_metadata.title: New Ti-Ta-Zr-Nb alloys with ultrahigh strength and elastic strain for potential orthopedic implant applications
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of the Mechanical Behavior of Biomedical Materials

evidence.quote: a new series of Ti-Ta-Zr-Nb alloys (Ti-38.3Ta-22Zr-8.1Nb, Ti-38.9Ta-25Zr-5Nb, Ti-39.5Ta-28Zr-2.5Nb, designated TTZN-1, TTZN-2, TTZN-3, respectively)

In this study, three new Ti-Ta-Zr-Nb alloys , namely Ti-38.3Ta-22Zr-8.1Nb (TTZN-1), Ti -
38.9Ta-25Zr-5Nb (TTZN-2) and Ti-39.5Ta-28Zr-2.5Nb (TTZN-3), have been designed and
fabricated with the cold-crucible levitation melting (CCLM) method .
The nominal compositions by weight percent (wt.%) of the designed TTZN alloys are Ti-38.3Ta-22Zr-8.1Nb (TTZN-1), Ti-38.9Ta-25Zr-5Nb (TTZN-2) and Ti-39.5Ta-28Zr-2.5Nb (TTZN-3).
The nominal compositions by weight percent (wt.%) of the designed TTZN alloys are Ti-38.3Ta-22Zr-8.1Nb (TTZN-1), Ti-38.9Ta-25Zr-5Nb (TTZN-2) and Ti-39.5Ta-28Zr-2.5Nb (TTZN-3).
